# DevConnect

**Discover → Match → Chat → Collaborate → Build** 

*The AI-powered developer collaboration platform. Find your next tech co-founder and build something great.*

## 📸 Preview

| Dashboard | Discover | Chat | Projects |
| - | - | - | - |
| Profile completeness, metrics, AI suggestions | Swipe-based developer discovery with filters | Real-time messaging with typing indicators | Kanban board, milestones, file sharing |



## ✨ Features

### Core Platform

- **Developer Profiles** — Bio, skills (proficiency 1–5), location, experience level, portfolio links, GitHub data sync

- **Profile Completeness** — 7-item checklist with animated progress ring and stage-based feedback

- **Skill Management** — Searchable skill autocomplete, tagging, proficiency ratings, endorsements

- **Avatars** — User-uploaded images or auto-generated initials via `ui-avatars.com`

- **Theme** — Full light/dark mode with `next-themes` and Tailwind v4 `@theme` color tokens

### Discovery & Matching

- **Swipe Feed** — Tinder-style card swiping with LIKE / PASS / SUPER\_LIKE actions

- **Drag Gestures** — Framer Motion-powered drag interactions with Like/Nope overlays

- **Filters** — Filter by skills, location, experience level, remote-only, availability

- **Sort** — Best Match / Newest sorting with URL-synced state

- **Auto-pagination** — Pre-fetches more profiles when running low

- **Undo** — 5-second undo window after each swipe

- **Match Modal** — Celebration screen on mutual match with score display

- **Recently Joined** — Horizontal carousel of newest developers

- **Search** — Debounced autocomplete search across developer names, skills, and keywords

- **Mobile Bottom Sheet** — Touch-friendly swipe controls on mobile viewports

### Real-time Chat

- **Socket.IO Gateway** — Live message delivery, typing indicators, presence (online/offline)

- **Optimistic Updates** — Messages appear instantly, confirmed via server acknowledgment

- **Offline Queue** — Messages queued locally when disconnected, sent on reconnection

- **Message Reactions** — Emoji reactions on individual messages

- **Message Editing & Deletion** — Edit or delete sent messages

- **Read Receipts** — Track message delivery and read status

- **Group Conversations** — Create groups, add/remove members

- **Attachments** — File uploads (images, documents, audio) with voice message recording

- **Message Search** — In-conversation text search with result navigation

- **Context Menus** — Right-click menus for message actions

- **Image Preview** — Lightbox modal for image attachments

### Projects & Collaboration

- **Project Management** — Create, list, and manage projects with full CRUD

- **Task Board** — Kanban-style task management (todo / in-progress / done)

- **Milestones** — Track project milestones with due dates and status

- **Project Members** — Role-based access (OWNER / CONTRIBUTOR / VIEWER)

- **File Sharing** — Upload and share files within projects

- **Invitations** — Send and manage collaboration invitations

### AI & Personalization

- **AI Suggestions** — Personalized developer and project recommendations (dashboard integration)

- **Reputation System** — Contribution tracking, collaboration pair analysis, impact scoring

- **Matching Engine** — Match score calculation and compatibility tagging

### Security & Trust

- **JWT Authentication** — Access + refresh token rotation with session management

- **OAuth Stubs** — GitHub and Google OAuth ready for configuration

- **MFA Support** — Multi-factor authentication secret management

- **Rate Limiting** — Global throttler (100 req/min) + granular swipe limits

- **Fraud Detection** — Risk scoring with signal analysis (rapid swiping, duplicate IP/device, low completion)

- **RBAC** — Role-based access control (DEVELOPER / RECRUITER / ADMIN / MODERATOR)

- **Moderation** — User reports, moderation actions, audit logs

- **Email Verification** — Token-based email verification flow

- **Password Reset** — Secure reset token flow with expiration

- **Security Headers** — HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, CSP-ready

### Developer Experience

- **API Keys** — Programmatic API access with key hashing

- **Swagger** — NestJS Swagger API documentation ready

- **Health Checks** — `/api/v1` health endpoint for monitoring

- **Seed Script** — Database seeding for development

- **Setup Script** — Automated environment validation

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- **Node.js** \>= 20.0.0

- **npm** \>= 10

- **Docker** (for local Redis + Meilisearch)

- **Supabase account** (for PostgreSQL database)

- **Railway account** (optional, for backend deployment)

- **Netlify account** (optional, for frontend deployment)

### Quick Start

```
\# 0. Run from the project root  
cd DevConnect  
  
\# 1. Start infrastructure (Redis + Meilisearch)  
docker compose up -d  
  
\# 2. Validate environment  
bash scripts/setup.sh  
  
\# 3. Backend setup  
cd backend  
npm install  
cp .env.example .env          \# Fill in your environment variables  
npm run prisma:generate        \# Generate Prisma client  
npm run prisma:migrate         \# Apply database migrations  
npm run seed                   \# Seed development data  
npm run start:dev              \# API at http://localhost:4000/api/v1  
  
\# 4. Frontend setup (new terminal)  
cd ../frontend  
npm install  
\# Create frontend/.env.local with the variables from the section below  
npm run dev                        \# App at http://localhost:3000
```

### Environment Variables

#### Backend (`backend/.env`)

```
\# Database (Supabase)  
DATABASE\_URL=postgresql://postgres:password@host:6543/postgres?pgbouncer=true  
DIRECT\_URL=postgresql://postgres:password@host:5432/postgres  
  
\# JWT  
JWT\_SECRET=your-jwt-secret  
JWT\_REFRESH\_SECRET=your-refresh-secret  
  
\# Redis  
REDIS\_URL=redis://:password@localhost:6379  
  
\# Meilisearch  
MEILISEARCH\_URL=http://localhost:7700  
MEILISEARCH\_API\_KEY=your-meilisearch-key  
  
\# Email (Resend)  
RESEND\_API\_KEY=re\_xxxxxxxxxxxx  
  
\# OAuth  
GITHUB\_CLIENT\_ID=your-github-client-id  
GITHUB\_CLIENT\_SECRET=your-github-client-secret  
GOOGLE\_CLIENT\_ID=your-google-client-id  
GOOGLE\_CLIENT\_SECRET=your-google-client-secret  
  
\# Platform  
FRONTEND\_URL=http://localhost:3000
```

#### Frontend (`frontend/.env.local`)

```
NEXT\_PUBLIC\_API\_URL=http://localhost:4000/api/v1  
NEXT\_PUBLIC\_WS\_URL=http://localhost:4000  
NEXT\_PUBLIC\_GITHUB\_CLIENT\_ID=your-github-client-id  
NEXT\_PUBLIC\_GOOGLE\_CLIENT\_ID=your-google-client-id
```


## 🔐 Authentication

- **Email/Password** — Registration with bcrypt-hashed passwords, JWT access token (short-lived) + refresh token (rotating)

- **OAuth Stubs** — Google and GitHub OAuth flows pre-wired (add your client IDs in env vars); the OAuth account storage layer is ready, token exchange endpoints need configuration

- **MFA** — Time-based one-time password (TOTP) support via QR secret

- **Session Management** — Refresh token rotation, device tracking, IP logging

- **Password Reset** — Token-based flow with expiration and usage tracking

- **Email Verification** — Token-verified email confirmation

- **API Keys** — Hash-stored keys for programmatic access with revocation support

The middleware (`frontend/middleware.ts`) handles route protection:

- Public routes (landing, auth pages, features, about, privacy) are accessible without auth

- Protected routes redirect to `/login?redirect=\<path\>` when unauthenticated

- Authenticated users on auth pages are redirected to `/dashboard`


## 🌐 Deployment

### Frontend (Netlify)

The `netlify.toml` configuration handles automatic deployment:

```
\[build\]  
  base = "frontend"  
  command = "npm ci && npx next build"  
  publish = ".next"
```

1. Connect your Netlify account to the GitHub repository

2. Set environment variables in Netlify dashboard

3. Deploy is automatic on push to `main`

### Backend (Railway)

The `railway.json` configuration handles automatic deployment:

```
\{  
  "build": \{ "builder": "DOCKERFILE" \},  
  "deploy": \{  
    "startCommand": "npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=src/prisma/schema.prisma && node dist/main",  
    "healthcheckPath": "/api/v1"  
  \}  
\}
```

1. Connect your Railway account to the GitHub repository

2. Set environment variables in Railway dashboard

3. Deploy is automatic on push to `main`

### CI/CD Pipeline

The GitHub Actions workflow (`deploy.yml`) validates both apps before deployment:

```
Push to main → Backend: lint + typecheck + build → Frontend: lint + typecheck + build ✅  
              → Railway auto-deploy (Docker build + migrate + start)  
              → Netlify auto-deploy (next build + publish)
```


## 📡 API Overview

The API is served at `/api/v1` (default: `http://localhost:4000/api/v1`).

## ⚡ Performance & Scaling

- **Redis Caching** — ioredis client for rate limit counters, swipe limit tracking, and BullMQ job queues

- **Connection Pooling** — Supabase `directUrl` for migrations, `DATABASE\_URL` with PgBouncer for connection pooling

- **Job Queues** — BullMQ backed by Redis for background jobs (email delivery, notifications, search indexing)

- **Search Indexing** — Meilisearch for full-text search with configurable index jobs

- **WebSocket Scaling** — Socket.IO adapter-ready for horizontal scaling across multiple instances

- **Image Optimization** — Next.js built-in image optimization with AVIF/WebP formats, 30-day CDN cache

- **Static Asset Caching** — Immutable cache headers for `\_next/static/\*` and font files (1 year)

- **Lazy Loading** — Dynamic imports for heavy components (MatchModal, KanbanBoard), virtualized lists with react-virtuoso

- **SSR Optimization** — Public pages use static generation where possible; protected pages use client-side data fetching

### Authentication

```
POST   /api/v1/auth/register     \# Create account  
POST   /api/v1/auth/login        \# Log in  
POST   /api/v1/auth/refresh      \# Refresh tokens  
POST   /api/v1/auth/logout       \# Log out
```

### Profiles

```
GET    /api/v1/users/me          \# Current user profile  
PATCH  /api/v1/users/me/profile  \# Update profile  
GET    /api/v1/profile/:id       \# Public profile
```

### Discovery

```
GET    /api/v1/discover          \# Profile feed (paginated, filterable)  
POST   /api/v1/discover/swipe    \# Record a swipe (LIKE/PASS/SUPER\_LIKE)  
POST   /api/v1/discover/undo     \# Undo last swipe
```

### Matching

```
GET    /api/v1/matches           \# List matches  
GET    /api/v1/matches/:id       \# Match detail
```

### Chat (REST)

```
GET    /api/v1/chat/conversations          \# List conversations  
POST   /api/v1/chat/conversations          \# Create conversation  
GET    /api/v1/chat/conversations/:id/messages  \# Get messages  
POST   /api/v1/chat/conversations/:id/messages  \# Send message
```

### Chat (WebSocket — Socket.IO on port 4000)

```
message:send        \# Send a message  
message:new         \# Receive new message (event)  
conversation:join   \# Join conversation room  
conversation:leave  \# Leave conversation room  
typing              \# Typing indicator  
message:edit        \# Edit a message  
message:delete      \# Delete a message  
message:react       \# Add reaction
```

### Projects

```
GET    /api/v1/projects          \# List projects  
POST   /api/v1/projects          \# Create project  
GET    /api/v1/projects/:id      \# Project detail
```

## 📊 Database Schema

The database includes **38 Prisma models** across these domains:

| Domain | Models |
| - | - |
| **Auth & Identity** | `User`, `Session`, `OAuthAccount`, `ApiKey`, `PasswordResetToken`, `NotificationPreference`, `UserDevice` |
| **Profile & Skills** | `Profile`, `Skill`, `ProfileSkill`, `Endorsement` |
| **Discovery** | `Swipe`, `Match`, `Connection`, `SavedProfile` |
| **Messaging** | `Conversation`, `ConversationMember`, `Message`, `MessageReaction` |
| **Projects** | `Project`, `ProjectMember`, `Task`, `Milestone`, `SharedFile`, `Invitation`, `Contribution` |
| **Collaboration** | `CollabRoom`, `CollabRoomParticipant`, `CollabRoomRecording`, `CollaborationPair` |
| **Platform** | `Notification`, `Report`, `ModerationAction`, `AuditLog`, `SwipeLimit`, `FraudFlag`, `Review`, `BlockedUser` |



## 🔍 SEO Strategy

- **Dynamic Metadata** — Every page has unique `\<title\>` and `\<meta description\>` with keyword targeting

- **Structured Data** — JSON-LD schemas for Organization, WebApplication, Product, FAQ, Breadcrumb

- **OpenGraph + Twitter Cards** — Rich preview cards for social sharing

- **Sitemap** — Auto-generated `sitemap.xml` with public page listings

- **Robots.txt** — Proper configuration allowing public paths, disallowing protected routes

- **Preconnect & DNS-Prefetch** — Optimized resource hints for external origins

- **Canonical URLs** — Prevent duplicate content across pages

- **SSR** — Pages render with full HTML content for search engine crawlers


## 🛡️ Security

| Feature | Implementation |
| - | - |
| **Authentication** | JWT (access + refresh tokens), bcrypt password hashing, OAuth stubs |
| **Authorization** | Role-based guard (DEVELOPER / RECRUITER / ADMIN / MODERATOR) |
| **Rate Limiting** | Global: 100 req/60s (ThrottlerGuard), Per-endpoint: swipe limits guard |
| **Fraud Detection** | Risk scoring engine with configurable signals |
| **API Security** | Helmet headers, CORS configuration, security headers (HSTS, XSS, frame options) |
| **Input Validation** | Class-validator + Zod schemas on all endpoints |
| **Database** | Row Level Security (RLS) policies on Supabase tables |
| **Session** | Refresh token rotation, IP logging, device tracking |
| **Email** | Verified email requirement, secure password reset flow |



## 📄 Pages

### Public Pages

`/` — Landing (hero, features, steps, testimonials, stats, CTA) `/features`, `/how-it-works`, `/about`, `/faq` — Information pages `/contact`, `/safety`, `/security`, `/privacy`, `/terms` — Trust & legal

### Auth Pages

`/login`, `/signup`, `/forgot-password`, `/reset-password` — Authentication flow `/auth/callback`, `/auth/google/callback` — OAuth callbacks

### Protected Pages

`/dashboard` — User dashboard with metrics, profile completeness, AI suggestions `/discover` — Swipe-based developer discovery with filters and search `/matches` — Active matches list `/chat` — Real-time messaging with conversations sidebar `/profile/\[id\]` — User profile viewing `/projects` — Project listing with Kanban board `/projects/create` — New project form `/projects/\[id\]` — Project detail with tasks and milestones `/invitations` — Collaboration invitation management `/notifications` — Notification center `/bookmarks` — Saved developer profiles `/settings` — User settings and preferences `/chat/settings` — Chat-specific settings (bubble style, privacy, notifications) `/blocked` — Blocked users management


## 🤝 Contributing

1. Fork the repository

2. Create a feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`)

3. Commit your changes (`git commit -m 'Add amazing feature'`)

4. Push to the branch (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`)

5. Open a Pull Request

**Branching Strategy:**

- `main` — Production-ready code

- `develop` — Integration branch

- `feature/\*` — Feature branches

- `fix/\*` — Bug fixes

**Before submitting:**

```
\# Frontend  
cd frontend && npm run verify   \# lint + typecheck + build  
  
\# Backend  
cd backend && npm run verify     \# lint + typecheck + build
```
